description: Use this when someone names a customer to update and you need that customer's id. Returns up to five customers whose name contains every word searched, each with its id, business and last edit time; never their contact details, tax id or address. Not for listing every customer.

businessId.description: Only customers of this business; every business of the account when absent

search.description: The customer's name as the user gave it, or part of it. Every word must appear in the stored name, in any order, ignoring case and accents.

name: find_customer

customers.description: The customers whose name matches, with the ids the other tools take. Contact details, dates of birth, notes and clinical records are never returned.

phoneEnding.description: The last two digits of the customer's phone, given only when two customers share this name

tooManyMatches.description: More than 5 customers match: none are returned; ask the user for more of the name

title: Find a customer by name
